This chapter demonstrates the same Quarto source-to-publication contract
with R. The rendered Markdown and figure remain stable inputs for Jekyll
and the manual PDF builder.

## A reproducible R figure

The figure is generated from the built-in `cars` dataset, so the fixture
does not require network access or external data.

``` r
plot(
  cars$speed,
  cars$dist,
  pch = 19,
  col = "#35b779",
  xlab = "Speed",
  ylab = "Stopping distance"
)
grid(col = "grey85")
```

![A scatter plot showing stopping distance increasing with speed]({{ site.baseurl }}/assets/img/generated/en/manual-computed-r/06-computed-r_files/figure-commonmark/fig-r-stopping-distance-1.png "Speed and stopping distance in the cars dataset")
